name: How much does it cost to install a comfort height toilet?

mainEntity.name: How much does it cost to install a comfort height toilet?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost to install a comfort height toilet typically ranges from $400 to $900 in the Bay Area. This estimate usually includes the toilet unit itself, which can vary widely in price based on brand and features, plus labor for removal of the old toilet, installation of the new one, and basic plumbing adjustments. Factors like extensive plumbing modifications, floor repairs, or complex toilet features can increase the overall cost. We provide detailed, transparent quotes after an on-site assessment.
acceptedAnswer.description: Installation costs for a comfort height toilet in the Bay Area generally range from $400 to $900, including the toilet unit and labor.
